asked_fact_assessments.asked_fact: Immediate complete agreed trades bind; three-plus-player trades bind if all aspects immediate and simultaneous.

support_locations.quote: An agreed trade that all participants can immediately and completely fulfill is binding and must be completed. Trades involving three or more players are binding when every part can resolve immediately and simultaneously. A future promise is nonbinding; either party may renege. If players cannot agree before the trade whether it is binding, it is nonbinding. For example, buying support at the moment that supporter must choose can be binding; buying a promise before that player's support opportunity is nonbinding. Trading an exhausted asset does not ready it, and receiving it does not count as claiming it.

support_locations.quote: A fully fulfillable immediate trade is binding. A trade of three or more players is binding if every part resolves immediately and simultaneously. A future promise is nonbinding; if binding status was not agreed beforehand, it is nonbinding.
